name: Lawrence Lancastor
original_name: ロレンス・ランカスター
source:
Lawrence is the Head of the Royal Guard under King Sergei. He joins Might on his quest by order of the king. He is a strong individual and a talented swordsman with a sturdy and serious attitude. He is very dedicated to the battle against Herdeus.

[From: [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/silver/silver.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
